tests: release-verify refuses a contaminated resolution path through the real path, through a symlink, and from a parent node_modules

consumesExternalOutput.program: npm install, spawned by scripts/release-verify.sh, and node's own module resolution over the installed prefix
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: scripts/release-verify.sh is a *.sh that spawns npm and node and records their exit codes, so rule (f)'s shell arm binds it. The capture is real output of both directions on 2026-08-14 with npm 11.18.0 and node v26.6.0. RESIDUE: the clean direction was run with --tarball, because nothing is published yet (owner action A-7 part 2 is outstanding), so the capture witnesses every step except which artifact npm fetched; the registry arm has NOT been captured and this witness does not claim it has. THREE MEMBERS, AND HRB-8 IS WHY. The previous pair both DELETED the same probe, which is two ways of removing one feature rather than two members of a class, and the dangerous state is the probe RUNNING AND ANSWERING WRONG. Member 0 removes the guard. Member 1 blinds Node resolution while leaving the probe intact and executing, so a parent node_modules that no ancestor package.json mentions reports clean. Member 2 leaves the probe and its answer intact and discards the answer in the classifier. Members 1 and 2 are wrong-answer states at two different points of one pipeline.
